definitions.short: Beer-Lachai-Roi , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H883. Beer Lachay Roi רֹאִי לַחַי בְּאֵר proper name, of a location (literally well of the living One that seeth me ) ** לַחַי perhaps originally I. לְחִי jaw(-bone) ; on proper name, of a location compared with לחי , γνάφος , see ᵐ5 Judg 15:9 We Prol. 344 Nes AJSL xiii {1897} 176 . Gen 16:14 (where explanation, from story of Hagar) 24:62 ; 25:11 (all J); perhaps name of ancient shrine or holy place, compare Sta ZAW ii. 347 & Di 16:14 ; west of Kadesh, compare Jerome below Barad, Lag Onom. 101, 2nd ed. 135 , see Rowlands in Williams Holy City, 489 Trumbull Kadesh-Barnea 64 .
definitions.rootNote: from 875 and 2416 (with prefix) and 7203 ; well of a living (One) my Seer;
